headline: Major U.S. Banks Restrict AI Agents Accessing Customer Accounts
summary: Major U.S. banks, including Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, are implementing stricter security measures to prevent AI agents from accessing customer accounts, signaling a significant shift in AI adoption and security concerns in the financial sector.
whyItMatters: This move highlights the growing security challenges and regulatory scrutiny surrounding AI in financial services, potentially setting a precedent for other industries.
